name: INSTRUCTIR
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate instruction-following ability in information retrieval models, focusing on user-aligned instructions tailored to each query instance to reflect diverse real-world search scenarios.
reputation: A newer retrieval benchmark that has attracted attention for measuring instruction-following in search systems, but is not yet a standard mainstream benchmark.
notes: Highlights potential overfitting issues in instruction-tuned retrievers; focuses on instruction-following in retrieval beyond task descriptions.
